cases.expected: collectorLoadMap should remain empty after invoking loadCollectors() when collectorMap is empty
cases.description: Verifies that loadCollectors() does nothing when there are no entries in collectorMap.

cases.expected: collectorLoadMap should contain a single entry with key 'c1' and value 'collected1' after invoking loadCollectors() when collectorMap has one Collector entry
cases.description: Verifies that a Collector instance is invoked and its result stored under the same key in collectorLoadMap.

cases.expected: collectorLoadMap should contain three entries with keys 'c1','c2','c3' and values 'v1','v2','v3' respectively after loadCollectors() when collectorMap holds three Collector entries
cases.description: Ensures that loadCollectors iterates over all entries and populates collectorLoadMap for each Collector.

cases.expected: collectorLoadMap should remain empty after loadCollectors() when collectorMap contains only non‑Collector objects (e.g., String, Integer)
cases.description: Confirms that entries whose values are not instances of Collector are skipped.

cases.expected: collectorLoadMap should contain only the entries for keys 'c1' and 'c3' with values 'val1' and 'val3' after loadCollectors() when collectorMap has a mix of Collector and non‑Collector values
cases.description: Tests that loadCollectors correctly processes Collector values while ignoring others in a mixed map.

cases.expected: collectorLoadMap should contain key 'nullCollector' with a null value after loadCollectors() when the Collector's collect() method returns null
cases.description: Verifies that a null result from collect() is stored as a null value in collectorLoadMap.

cases.expected: loadCollectors() should propagate the RuntimeException thrown by the Collector's collect() method
cases.description: Ensures that loadCollectors does not swallow exceptions from a failing Collector.

cases.expected: collectorLoadMap should contain the new values 'new1' for key 'c1' after a second call to loadCollectors() when collectorMap still has a Collector for 'c1' but its collect() now returns a different value
cases.description: Checks that subsequent invocations replace previous entries rather than preserving stale data.

cases.expected: ConcurrentModificationException should be thrown when a Collector's collect() method modifies collectorMap during loadCollectors execution
cases.description: Tests that loadCollectors propagates ConcurrentModificationException if a Collector alters collectorMap (e.g., adds a new entry) while iteration is in progress.
